## Summary
Complete monorepo foundation setup for ShopSphere e-commerce platform.

**What's included:**
- .NET 8.0 with central package management (MassTransit 8.3.3, EF Core 8.0.x)
- Dev container with all tools (SDK, Node, Docker, Terraform, gh CLI)
- MCP servers: GitHub, Notion, Context7, Microsoft Learn, Terraform, Postman
- Vendored Superpowers and skill-creator skills with provenance
- Architecture rules in AGENTS.md (service boundaries, messaging, consistency)
- Docker Compose infrastructure (SQL Server, RabbitMQ, Redis)
- Bootstrap and doctor health-check scripts
- CI workflow (build + dev container verification)

## Architecture Checklist
- [x] Service boundaries documented (each owns data/schema)
- [x] Message envelope format specified (MessageId, CorrelationId, CausationId)
- [x] Idempotency pattern documented
- [x] Transactional outbox pattern documented
- [x] Timeout handling guidance (unknown vs failure)
- [x] Late events handling documented
- [x] Concurrency control approach (EF Core tokens)
- [x] Postman MCP integration for API documentation

## Testing
Second developer can:
1. Clone repo
2. Open in dev container
3. Copy .env.example to .env, add tokens
4. Run bash scripts/doctor.sh
5. Start infra: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up -d
6. Begin service implementation

## Known Issues
- CODEOWNERS line 6 has placeholder TEAMMATE_USERNAME (update when known)
- Node 22.x instead of 20.x in current environment (not blocking)
- jq, pnpm, terraform not in PATH (install if needed)
